stage1.impression: A warm, well-observed late-sun interior: plaster, oak floor and window light are convincing, and the green light passing through the cabinets onto the credenza and floor is the right idea. But it is staged like a configurator. The frontal symmetry, the dead-centre credenza and the flat back wall give it no foreground and no air. The cabinet interiors read as saturated neon-green CG plastic rather than tinted cast acrylic over white batts, and the walnut credenza looks like a printed laminate.

blocking_9: Cabinet interiors read as tinted acrylic over white batts, near the reference #B2C9A2 (delta_e2000 < 10 in the side-rib regions), not as neon-green plastic (now 12.5 to 21.6)
Depth from foreground to background: one real out-of-focus foreground element, and visible air in the sunbeam
Credenza reads as real oiled walnut (grain relief, sheen variation), not as a flat printed veneer
No crushed void at the window sill trench (crush_pct in the left strip near 0)
Speakers hold the eye ahead of the credenza sun stripe and the wall: the speaker fronts are no darker than the floor, and the wall does not approach clipping
Composition has a point of view (a weighted asymmetry or a lead-in), not catalogue symmetry around the credenza

defects.what: Left cabinet interior (ribs, batts, port block) reads as a saturated green plastic toy; delta_e2000 to #B2C9A2 is 12.5 at the rib and 21.6 at the port block
Same on the right cabinet; the port block at 2080-2200 x 1270-1330 is near clipping in green (g 209)
Walnut credenza doors look like a flat printed decal: no pore relief, uniform sheen, and too-perfect cathedral grain repeated across three doors

The sun stripe on the centre door (r238 g190 b151, twice the surrounding door's luminance) with a yellow-green fringe is the brightest mid-frame object and reads as a stain or reflection rather than as light through the speaker
Window sill floor trench is a pure black slot; crush_pct 0.78 in the left strip
Hard dark wedge at the top right of the wall (median 104 against the wall's 225) splits the wall diagonally and pulls the eye to the corner
Left horn's shadow on the wall behind the turntable and vase is a large ambiguous dark blob crowding the props
Frontal, perfectly symmetric staging with no foreground and everything sharp at f/5.6; no atmosphere in the sunbeams, so it reads as an archviz render
Heading wall near clipping (median 225, p95 233, clip 0.69%) while the speaker covers sit at 110-130, so the wall outshines the product

changes.problem: The cabinet interiors read as oversaturated neon green, not as light through tinted acrylic over white batts, which makes the hero look like CG plastic.

evidence.measured: rib median rgb 127/168/104, delta_e2000 12.5 to #B2C9A2; port block 600-720 x 1270-1330 delta_e 21.6; right port block g 209

change.to: 0.5, applied to mid-tones and highlights of greens

changes.expected: Interior ribs and batts read paler and milkier, closer to #B2C9A2, with the tint kept in the 20 mm walls and edges

changes.problem: The wall outshines the product: the speakers sit a stop below the wall, and the heading wall is close to clipping.

evidence.measured: wall median 225, p95 233, clip 0.69%; speaker covers 520-820 x 820-1180 median 110, 2080-2380 median 130

changes.expected: Wall drops to about 210 with plaster texture kept, and the speaker fronts hold about 115-135 so they read as the brightest coloured objects

changes.problem: Catalogue symmetry around a dead-centre credenza with no foreground gives the image no point of view and no depth.

evidence.measured: seen: mirror-symmetric staging, all planes sharp at f/5.6, empty foreground floor

change.to: chair on at [-1.55, -2.6, 0.0] rotate 200 so its arm and back enter the lower-left corner, out of focus; camera x 0.3 (still squared, verticals straight), f/4

changes.expected: A soft dark foreground edge at lower left leads into the left speaker. The frame weights left toward the window and light, and the right speaker sits against the open wall.

changes.problem: The walnut credenza reads as printed laminate and its three doors repeat the same cathedral grain.

evidence.measured: seen: uniform sheen and no pore relief; door median lum 97-114 with identical grain figures

change.to: add a 0.3 mm pore bump from the texture's roughness, oiled finish roughness 0.45 with a 0.15 variation map, and offset the UVs per door so no figure repeats

changes.expected: Door faces show fine pore texture and soft sheen variation in the sun stripe. Each door's figure is different.

changes.problem: A crushed black slot at the window sill reads as a hole in the set.

evidence.measured: left strip crush_pct 0.78; trench is a pure black void

change.to: a linear floor grille in the frame colour #5A5650 at 60% open area, with a mid-grey base 30 mm below

changes.expected: The sill reads as a heating-grille detail with visible slats, and no pixels below 10

changes.problem: There is no atmosphere: the sunbeam is invisible in the air, so the room has no depth and the light through the cabinets is not felt.

evidence.measured: seen: air between window and wall is perfectly clear and the beams show only where they land

change.to: homogeneous scatter volume filling the room, density 0.004, anisotropy 0.6

changes.expected: Faint warm shafts from the window, with a green tint behind each cabinet. Background contrast drops slightly and the shafts separate the planes.

changes.problem: The hard dark wedge at the top right of the wall cuts the wall diagonally and draws the eye to the corner.

evidence.measured: median 104 against the wall's 225 inside the sun patch

changes.expected: The shadow wedge still reads as shade but opens to about 125-140, so the wall reads as one plane with a sun patch

changes.problem: The left horn's shadow lands as a dark blob behind the turntable and vase, crowding the props and confusing their silhouettes.

evidence.measured: p5 102 against p95 228 inside the prop group; the shadow overlaps the vase's left edge

change.to: vase at [0.48, 0.75, 0.56] (fully in sun, clear of the shadow); books at [-0.62, 0.71, 0.56]

changes.expected: The vase reads against lit plaster, and the shadow falls on bare wall between the turntable and the vase

out_of_scope.request: Make the interior batts visibly white or quilted (voile sleeves) behind the tint, rather than reading as solid green blocks
out_of_scope.why: This is the speaker's own interior construction and material; it is fixed by the card. Only the grade and the light (c1, c2) are adjusted here.

out_of_scope.request: Hide or simplify the port block and bracing visible through the acrylic, which clutter the silhouette
out_of_scope.why: These are the speaker's parts; fixed.
